name: Custom Craft Inc
old_description: High quality, fashionable cushions that will stand up to the elements
about:
Custom Craft Inc operates from West Warwick, Rhode Island, where it has produced outdoor cushions and related products for nearly three decades. The company is family owned and operated, rooted in textile and manufacturing traditions, though the exact founding year and founders’ names are not publicly disclosed. The business began with a focus on high‑quality, fashionable cushions designed to withstand the elements.

The firm manufactures outdoor cushions, pads, umbrellas, canopies, and pillows using durable all‑weather fabrics and modern techniques. It offers custom‑crafting variations on standard styles and specializes in sizing for non‑standard items. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

Custom Craft serves outdoor furniture manufacturers, retailers, and specialty patio stores throughout the northeastern United States. Its products are used as replacements for wicker, teak, wrought iron, aluminum, and rattan furniture. Specific customers mentioned include Bryant Industries and WHS Industries.

The company emphasizes personal service, flexibility, and expedited turnaround as key differentiators, along with a focus on selection, quality, and price. Its family‑owned structure allows direct attention to each order.
